nodes.title: Add Docker deployment files for Deploy-Manager
nodes.summary: Add the files Deploy-Manager needs to build and run paper-cutout: a root Dockerfile, an nginx.conf that serves the app on port 8000, and a .dockerignore. Update the README to describe this setup and drop the references to the unused deploy-manager.json and .nvmrc.
